description:
Everybody has something in their toolbox that pushes them when motivation disappears.

Not hype.
Not a morning routine.
Not some perfectly curated mindset.

I mean the thing that instantly reminds you who you do and don’t want to become.

Sometimes motivation doesn’t come from chasing a dream. Sometimes it comes from refusing to repeat a pattern.

The people who keep moving aren’t always the most inspired.
They’re usually the ones with enough clarity to know what staying the same would cost them.
transcript: This is going to sound horrible, but you know what's in my toolbox when I really won't move? I'll say, if you don't do this, you're going to end up like your father. Oh, man. I don't keep it. It's like nitrous oxide in the car. I hit the button. I get going fast. I'm parking that. I can go back to a compelling future.
